title: Building owner's scientist boyfriend told her of a New Mexico crash with bodies

tellings.quote: husband boyfriend at the time in the early 50s told her he was a very prominent scientist that a spaceship crashed in New Mexico and that there were bodies Al I recovered

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFO stories, says an 88-year-old woman who owned a building told him about a man she was seeing in the early 1950s. According to Fox, she said this man was a very prominent scientist, and he told her that a spaceship had crashed in New Mexico and that bodies were recovered. If true, it would be an early inside account of a crashed craft with its crew.
